channel.title: Lilly Looks UK
channel.description: TikTok-viral skincare, makeup and beauty essentials for UK shoppers — showcase site, all orders via TikTok Shop.

item.g:title: Multicoloured Rhinestone Face Gem Stickers
item.g:description: Self-adhesive rhinestone face gem stickers in a mix of colours and sizes for festival makeup, party looks and TikTok glam. Easy to apply around the eyes, cheeks and hairline, then peel off when the night is over.

item.g:title: Vegan 8PCS Mini Travel Makeup Brush Set
item.g:description: A complete 8-piece mini makeup brush set with vegan-friendly synthetic bristles, sized for travel and handbags. Covers the everyday essentials for foundation, powder, blush and eyeshadow application on the go.

item.g:title: Nail Gem Stones & Face Gems
item.g:description: A double-duty gem kit with nail gem stones and face gems for sparkling manicures and festival makeup looks. Mix and match the stones to decorate nails, eyes and cheeks for parties, photos and nights out.

item.g:title: Mini Travel Makeup Brush Set
item.g:description: A compact mini makeup brush set with the essential brushes for touch-ups anywhere, in a travel-friendly size that slips into a handbag or makeup bag. Soft bristles for smooth application of powder, blush and eyeshadow.

item.g:title: Luxury Satin Bonnet for Sleeping
item.g:description: A luxury satin bonnet for sleeping that covers your hair overnight, helping to reduce friction, frizz and tangles while you sleep. A night-time hair care staple for curly, wavy and straight hair, protective styles and blow-dries.

item.g:title: Multicoloured Crystal
item.g:description: A multicoloured crystal piece that catches the light from every angle. Use it as a decorative accent on shelves, desks and dressing tables, or as a colourful gift for crystal lovers.

item.g:title: Premium Beauty Blender in a Cup
item.g:description: A soft beauty blender sponge for blending foundation, concealer and cream products, stored in its own hygienic cup to keep it clean between uses. Use it damp for a smooth, even base.

item.g:title: Neck & Chin Tightening Cream With Roller
item.g:description: A neck and chin cream with a built-in cooling roller applicator, made for the neck and jawline area as part of your daily skincare routine. The roller makes application easy and mess-free — a TikTok skincare favourite.

item.g:title: Soft Makeup Powder Puff Set
item.g:description: A set of ultra-soft makeup powder puffs for applying loose and pressed powder, foundation and setting makeup with a smooth, even finish. A makeup bag essential for baking, touch-ups and a soft-focus base.

item.g:title: Shimmer Spray
item.g:description: A body shimmer spray that adds an all-over glow and sparkle to skin — a party and holiday favourite for shoulders, collarbones and legs. Mist it on before a night out for a light-catching finish.

item.g:title: Portable Mini Handheld Fan
item.g:description: A portable mini handheld fan for staying cool on the go — and a makeup favourite for setting sprays and speeding up skincare. Compact and handbag-sized for travel, festivals and hot days.

item.g:title: Teeth Whitening Strips - 14 Strips
item.g:description: Teeth whitening strips for at-home whitening, with 14 strips for upper and lower teeth in every pack. A popular UK choice for adding a whitening step to your routine without a trip to the dentist.

item.g:title: Waterproof Brow Gel
item.g:description: A waterproof brow gel made to set, shape and define brows as part of your daily makeup routine. The smudge-proof formula is designed to hold brow hairs in place from morning to night.

item.g:title: Waterproof Matte Lip Liner
item.g:description: A waterproof matte lip liner for defining the lip line — wear it under lipstick or on its own for a neat, polished lip look. A long-wearing makeup bag staple in a classic matte finish.

item.g:title: Peel-Off Liquid Lipstick
item.g:description: The viral peel-off liquid lipstick: apply it, let it set, then peel it away to reveal a lip stain underneath. A TikTok favourite for lip colour without reapplying lipstick through the day.

item.g:title: Viral 18-Color Eyeshadow Palette
item.g:description: An 18-colour eyeshadow palette with a mix of matte and shimmer shades for everyday looks and full glam. Blendable, highly pigmented colours for soft daytime eyes or bold party makeup.

item.g:title: Romantic Bear Peel-Off Lip Tattoo
item.g:description: The Romantic Bear peel-off lip tattoo in its cute bear-shaped tube — a peel-off lip tint that leaves a natural-looking stain on the lips. Apply, peel and go: the TikTok-viral lip stain for colour without constant touch-ups.
